scope: v29 local-only bytes, following the v28 convention: regenerable contract/probe CMake builds, replay frames, the in-run MP4 duplicate of the tracked output copy, and the physical run's raw captures. Sources, scripts, logs (including scan.log), receipts, reviews and results are tracked.

regeneration.caches: Each enclosing run keeps request.json, inside.sh and probe_source (or waiver_contract/source with run.py). Rerun it into a new directory against the named native tree; the versions/v29 manifest and runtime/scan61_sensor_column_v29/source_sha256.json fix the sources.
regeneration.frames: Rerun scripts/render_episode.py --source-run v29_historical_full01 through scripts/run_bounded.py. frames.json keeps per-frame hashes; the tracked MP4 is output/2026-09-27_lite3_versions/v29_historical_full_replan_exhausted.mp4.
regeneration.raw: Not regenerable. These are the recorded physical-run captures; preserve at the exact project paths.
